rationale: The decision from the Dutch Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal (CBb) concerns the Wet verantwoorde groei melkveehouderij (Responsible Growth in Dairy Farming Act), which amended the Meststoffenwet to regulate dairy herd expansion and agricultural manure/phosphate limits. Under the protocol rules, Dutch agricultural manure and phosphate quota disputes under the Meststoffenwet framework are classified as NOT_WATER and not_water_related.
